issue_request: FHIR-15791 was Published with Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Account. It requested clearer short descriptions and definitions distinguishing Account.owner as the entity managing the account, Account.guarantor as parties ultimately responsible for balancing the account, and Account.subject as the entity that caused/incurred the expenses.
initial_application: The change was explicitly applied to the old source/account/account-spreadsheet.xml in commit 64b306c3b5f7c952c2c1ca3c17a64474625dd16f and merged by 848d7f91c3d10f924d501ea37b5513452ac025bb. Later source rework converted the Account spreadsheet into source/account/structuredefinition-Account.xml while preserving the approved text.
additional_context: Account is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current build-scope source Account StructureDefinition has the approved wording. Supporting Account search-parameter descriptions and generated-looking diagrams also reflect the updated descriptions. R4, R5, and current build JSON publication surfaces match current source. Searches found no stale old wording in current source and no linked related Jira issue or conflicting Zulip/Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The published empty audit commit records that the current specification already satisfies FHIR-15791 and that additional edits would be redundant.
